Offensively, Breece Hall practiced fully after the camp groin issue and gives Geno Smith and Frank Reich a dependable early-down and checkdown answer. Tennessee will be without linebacker Cedric Gray, while the Jets lose edge depth with Joseph Ossai out. The Micks number lands at 81/110, with the replica model at 84/100 and an 8/10 failure score, enough support for a 0.75-unit position rather than a full-unit release. That volatility argues for taking points, not laying them after the steam. Week 1 uncertainty around Murray's first start also raises variance. Best Number is Vikings -1 at -110 or better; Playable To is -1.5 at -115; No-Bet Cutoff is -2.5, with a mandatory rescore and likely pass at -3. Minnesota -1.5 -114 remains the official B+ position.
